title: AI Teaches Humans to Handle Complexity in the Game of Go
abstract: arXiv:2610.33323v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Strategic decision-making in complex environments requires balancing local stability against global coordination. Using the game of Go as a bounded empirical testbed, we investigate how biological and artificial agents navigate this trade-off by formalizing a network-derived metric of strategic tension defined via the spectral radius of spatial dependency matrices. Across human skill progression, tension systematically decays from novices to masters as uncoordinated tactical skirmishes give way to disciplined territorial stabilization. However, a longitudinal analysis of professional play spanning 1980--2026 reveals a striking historical paradox: following the superhuman breakthrough of AlphaGo in 2016, elite human matches display a marked surge in sustained tension. A two-dimensional projection based on move distance and captures places modern professionals close to neural engines, separating their tension from the local contact fightin

translated_title: AI教会人类应对围棋中的复杂性
translated_abstract: 复杂环境中的战略决策需要在局部稳定性与全局协调之间取得平衡。我们以围棋游戏作为有界的实证测试平台，通过将一个源自网络的“战略张力”指标形式化（该指标由空间依赖矩阵的谱半径定义），研究生物智能体与人工智能体如何应对这一权衡。在人类技能进阶过程中，张力从新手到大师系统性衰减，无协调的战术混战逐渐让位于有纪律的势力稳定化。然而，对1980年至2026年职业对局的纵向分析揭示了一个引人注目的历史悖论：继2016年AlphaGo实现超越人类的突破之后，顶尖人类对局中呈现出持续张力的显著激增。基于行棋距离与提子数的二维投影显示，现代职业棋手的落点接近神经网络引擎，使其张力区别于局部的接触战斗。
tldr: 该研究提出以空间依赖矩阵谱半径度量的“战略张力”指标，发现人类棋力越高张力越低，但2016年AlphaGo问世后职业棋手的对局张力反而显著激增并趋近AI水平，表明AI反向教会了人类驾驭更复杂的局面。
en_tdlr: Using a strategic tension metric derived from the spectral radius of spatial dependency matrices, this study shows that while human skill progression suppresses tension, elite Go matches exhibited a striking surge toward AI-like complexity after AlphaGo's 2016 breakthrough, suggesting AI has taught humans to handle greater complexity.
